description: This file defines classes and functions related to animations in the Kivy framework, including the Animation class, various transition functions, and composite animation classes.

classes.name: Animation
classes.description: Class for creating and managing property animations on widgets.

classes.name: CompoundAnimation
classes.description: Base class for composite animations combining multiple animations.

classes.name: Sequence
classes.description: Class for sequential animations, running animations one after another.

classes.name: Parallel
classes.description: Class for running multiple animations in parallel.

classes.name: AnimationTransition
classes.description: Collection of static methods implementing various easing functions for animations.

methods.name: stop_all
methods.description: Stops all animations associated with a widget or specific properties.

methods.name: cancel_all
methods.description: Cancels all animations associated with a widget or specific properties.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the animation on a widget.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the animation on a widget, triggering on_complete.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the animation on a widget without triggering on_complete.

methods.name: stop_property
methods.description: Removes a property from being animated, stopping its animation.

methods.name: cancel_property
methods.description: Removes a property from being animated, canceling its animation.

methods.name: have_properties_to_animate
methods.description: Checks if a widget still has properties to animate.
